---
title: "Projects"
---

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import yaml

with open('../data/projects.yaml', 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f)

projects = data.get('projects') or []

categories = {}
for proj in projects:
    cat = proj['category']
    if cat not in categories:
        categories[cat] = []
    categories[cat].append(proj)

for cat, proj_list in categories.items():
    print(f"## {cat}\n")
    for proj in proj_list:
        status = f" *({proj['status']})*" if proj.get('status') else ""
        print(f"### {proj['title']}{status}\n")
        print(f"{proj['description']}\n")
        if proj.get('problem'):
            print(f"**Problem addressed:** {proj['problem']}\n")
        tools = ", ".join(proj['tools'])
        print(f"**Tools:** {tools}\n")
        links = []
        if proj.get('github'):
            links.append(f"[GitHub]({proj['github']})")
        if proj.get('url'):
            links.append(f"[Project site]({proj['url']})")
        if links:
            print(" | ".join(links))
        print()
    print("---\n")
```
